description: Oro Loma monitoring covers twelve experimental wetland cells in San Lorenzo, California, with different plants, soils and topography. Measurements include influent and effluent flow, nutrients, water quality and porewater nitrate and chloride. This resource is provided by Aidan Cecchetti. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The horizontal-levee test facility is an experiment; transfer requires matching hydrology and treatment conditions. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
